text: How to forget your ex. This is a popular question many men ask. A lot of men suffer because they can't forget their ex. For days, weeks, months, sometimes even years. And if that's you, listen carefully, even if some of these things are unpleasant to hear. First, you must realize that getting back with an ex is a path to nowhere. It is a dead end and under no circumstances should you allow it to happen. You might think that if you win her back, things will be different this time. This time you can make it work. You will be the best people for each other. Spoiler alert, no. Even if you get back together, the respect would be gone. The dynamics would be even worse. And deep down, both of you would know it. Only weak men try to rebuild relationships that have already been destroyed. A strong man accepts that the past is over. Anyone telling you that you might get back together is not your friend. There are people who want you to suffer. So step one is brutal, but necessary. Accept that this chapter is over. Completely. Second, stop dramatizing the situation. It is just a breakup with a girl with whom things didn't work out. It isn't a catastrophe or a death sentence. It is actually your chance to build a better, happier life with someone else. Yes, it hurts. Yes, it's painful. But this is not the end of the world. What also helps is a change of perspective. Go to a hospital or an animal shelter and volunteer to work there for a day. There, people and animals deal with real loss, pain, illness, and survival. Compared to that, a failed relationship is not such a big deal. Third, cut all contact. Completely. If she is your ex, her life is no longer your concern. You need to stop following her life entirely. You should care about her as much as you care about a random stranger on the street. Delete her from every social network and block her so she cannot contact you. It doesn't matter if she thinks it's childish. You need to minimize every reminder of her. If there are things in your house connected to her, throw them away. Clear out your photos and shared posts so they don't haunt your memories. External changes lead to internal changes. If you want to change how you feel inside, start by changing how you look outside. Start going to the gym or do some other sports. The hormones from exercising will help you feel better. Start loving yourself by buying new clothes or getting a new haircut. Allow yourself to become a new version of yourself. These physical changes will pull your internal state forward into your new life. Fifth, redirect your emotions. Another reason you are hurting is that you shared many emotions, memories, and routines You need to redirect that emotional energy. Focus on your hobbies and spend time on things that truly interest you. Go on dates with other women. Even if you don't feel like it, treat dating as a headache pill. It might not taste good, but it works. The more new interests and people you bring into your life, the easier it becomes to switch your brain off the past. Another point is, stop talking about your ex with your friends, family, or anyone else. Tell them the topic is closed. Don't listen to depressing music or watch psychologists who encourage you to stay in your pain. Everyone heals at a different pace. It might take weeks or months. But the most important thing is never to take a step back. The moment you do that, you reset all progress. This phase will pass. Every man goes through it. And one day, you will look back and think, why did I even suffer so much over this? Because the version of you that comes next will be stronger, better, and happier. Move forward. Time works for men who don't stand still.
